This is the next frame of the same illustrated elderly grandmother, strict left-facing side view, seated after setting down her basin and now placing both palms on her knees to prepare to rise.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the actual edit target, already positioned. Image 2 is only the pink repair-domain guide. Image 3 explains near/far occlusion and the palm-to-knee contact surfaces; colored marks and dashed construction lines are explanatory only. Image 4 is the preceding approved cel, identity, line and material reference only, not the new pose.
PRIMARY LOCAL REPAIR: In Image 1 join the neck to the shoulder/collar without a white gap or old pointed fragments; connect the near sleeve outlet, fleshy upper arm, elbow and forearm into one continuous natural bent arm with the shown thickness. Keep the left wrist and its one green jade bangle at the shown position. Draw the left hand as a genuine weight-bearing PALM-DOWN hand resting broadly on the upper/front curve of the nearest navy-clothed knee. The current raised-thumb free-hand shape is only a placement placeholder: relax the thumb alongside the knee and lay the palm down, with fingers gently following the knee's forward curve. Show broad lower-palm contact and a small contact shadow; no air gap, no grasp of the other hand, no clenched fist.
The far right bare hand bears on the farther knee behind the near hand/leg. Its wrist and arm stay behind the navy pants/torso, only the small exposed fingers and wrist at the far-knee edge are visible. Do not draw the dashed hidden forearm across the pants; no forearm emerging from the chest, no dangling extra hand, no hand-to-hand clasp.
Repair only the newly exposed upper-pants cloth and the small waist/hip gaps beneath the shifted shirt: restore real rounded knee/thigh volume, continuous navy folds and the blue floral shirt draping over the fixed seated hip. Remove old cut-piece edges. Keep the large existing back floral interior and the seated bottom contour.
INVARIANTS: Preserve exactly the current head silhouette, face, glasses, gray bun and red hairpin; strict side identity and mature body thickness. Keep the pose's head/torso angle and every original lower leg, ankle, shoe and grounded basin in place. Same complete cream enamel basin with blue rim and green bean pods, same proportions and same floor position. Both feet and seated hip stay planted; she has NOT lifted off the stool yet. No new objects, furniture, background, floor, text, labels or guide marks. No global scaling, no recentering, no color-temperature change. Same clean hand-drawn ink outlines, blue flower blouse, navy pants and warm skin. Output only the repaired cel on genuine transparent background, preserving the full original canvas extent.
